requirements.title: The topic tree in the enrichment request
requirements.rationale: Link counts and the preference for the most used topics are what drew most links into one broad topic.

criteria.condition: the enrichment worker builds the request for a link
criteria.action: list under 'Existing topics:' up to 100 of the owner's topics, one per line, each as its full path with ' > ' between the names, choosing the 100 whose newest link, filed under the topic or under a topic beneath it, was added most recently, and giving no link count for any topic
criteria.contract: the request holds the path of each of those topics on a line of its own (for example 'Software engineering > Testing'), no other topic, and no '(<number>)' after any topic

setup: the owner has 103 top-level topics T000..T102, each with one link, T000 the oldest and T102 the newest
and 'Software engineering' > 'Testing', whose only link (under 'Testing') is the newest of all
check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts in 'enriching a fetched link', beside 'lists the 300 most used tags in the request': enrich a link with FakeAi; body = the request's prompt; assert the lines 'Software engineering > Testing' and 'Software engineering' are present, T005..T102 are present and T000..T004 absent (100 topics in all), and no listed topic is followed by '(' and a number

criteria.action: ask in the request for the topic as a path of one to three names from the most general to the most specific, separated by ' > ', telling the provider to file the page under the most specific topic that fits, existing or new, and to put a new topic under the existing topic it belongs to, and describe the result's topic so in the structured result asked of the model
criteria.contract: the prompt holds those instructions and no instruction to prefer the more used topics; RESULT_SCHEMA's topic description asks for a path of one to three names separated by ' > '

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, a new describe 'the enrichment request' calling buildPrompt directly with two topic paths and two tags: assert the prompt asks for a path of one to three names from the most general to the most specific separated by ' > ', for the most specific topic that fits, existing or new, and for a new topic under the existing one it belongs to; assert the only 'preferring the more used' instruction is about tags; assert RESULT_SCHEMA.properties.topic.description mentions ' > ' and three names

criteria.action: keep the tags part of the request as it was: up to 300 tags, each with its link count, and the instruction to reuse an existing tag when one fits, preferring the more used ones

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, keep 'lists the 300 most used tags in the request' (the 300 used tags present with their counts, such as 'tag-100 (1)', the unused ones absent) and assert the prompt still tells the provider to reuse an existing tag, preferring the more used ones

requirements.title: Filing the link under the returned path
requirements.rationale: Enrichment grows the tree by itself, but never moves a topic the owner has placed.

criteria.condition: the provider returns a topic of one or more names separated by >
criteria.action: split it on every >, trim each name, and resolve the names from the first: a name equal ignoring case to a topic's name, else to a topic alias, else a near name of a topic, uses that topic where it is in the tree, and the next name belongs under it; any other name is created under the topic the name before it resolved to, or at the top level for the first name; then file the link under the topic the last name resolved to
criteria.contract: the link's topic is the last resolved topic's name and its topic_path that topic's path; no existing topic's parent changes; no topic is left with no link and no child

setup: the owner has 'Software engineering' > 'Testing' > 'Fuzzing' and a top-level 'Databases', each with a link, and the alias 'SE' of 'Software engineering'
check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts in 'enriching a fetched link', a table 'files the link under the returned path $topic': {'Software engineering > Unit tests' -> ['Software engineering', 'Unit tests']}, {'software engineering' -> ['Software engineering']}, {'SE > Mocks' -> ['Software engineering', 'Mocks']}, {'Database > Indexes' -> ['Databases', 'Indexes'] (near name)}, {'Quality > Testing' -> ['Software engineering', 'Testing'], Testing's parent unchanged and no 'Quality' left}, {'Programming>Rust' -> ['Programming', 'Rust']}, {'Gardening > Tools > Shears > Blades' -> ['Gardening', 'Tools', 'Blades']}, {'Fuzzing > Corpus' -> ['Software engineering', 'Testing', 'Corpus']}; for each: FakeAi answers {summary, tags, topic}; enrich the link; assert GET /api/v1/links/{id} gives topic and topic_path; assert no topic name holds '>' and no topic has neither a link nor a child

criteria.condition: the returned path has more than three names
criteria.action: keep its first two names and its last, and resolve those
criteria.contract: the link's topic_path holds at most three names, the last being the returned path's last name or the existing topic it matched

criteria.condition: a new name of the returned path would be created at level 4, because the name before it matched an existing level-3 topic
criteria.action: create the new topic under the parent of that level-3 topic and file the link under it
criteria.contract: the new topic's parent is the level-3 topic's parent; the link's topic_path has three names

criteria.action: for any enrichment result, create no topic whose name holds >

criteria.condition: the returned path holds an empty name or a name longer than 100 characters
criteria.action: treat the result as unusable: record the enrichment as failed and leave the link's summary, tags and topic as they were, retrying a first automatic attempt once as for any unusable result
criteria.contract: enrichment_status 'failed', enrichment_reason 'the result was not usable'; summary, tags and topic unchanged; no topic created; one retry sent with attempt 2 and a delay of 600 seconds

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/enrich.test.ts, extend the table of 'a failed enrichment' ('after $label keeps the link usable, marks it failed and retries once in 10 minutes') with {a topic path with an empty name: topic 'A >  > B'}, {a topic path ending in >: topic 'A >'}, {a topic name over 100 characters: topic 'A > ' + 'x'.repeat(101)}; for those rows also assert enrichment_reason == 'the result was not usable' and that the user has no topic

criteria.condition: the owner has edited the link's topic
criteria.action: keep the owner's topic whatever path the provider returns, while storing the rest of the result

check.pseudocode: in src/worker/enrich/edits.test.ts, extend 'keeps the owner’s $field through $op, while the rest updates' so that the second answer's topic is the path 'Second topic > Deeper': when the topic is the edited field the link keeps 'Owner topic'; otherwise its topic is 'Deeper' with topic_path ['Second topic', 'Deeper']

execution_paths.title: A new link is enriched into a new sub-topic of an existing topic

steps.action: adds a link, having a link filed under the topic 'Software engineering' and a verified AI key
fetches the page and hands the link to enrichment
sends the request, listing 'Software engineering' without a link count
creates 'Testing' under 'Software engineering' and files the link under it
shows the card's topic 'Testing', the detail page's breadcrumb and 'Testing' under 'Software engineering' on the Topics page
answers topic:"software engineering" with the link

setup: wrangler dev is running with the fake Google provider, the fake origin and the fake AI provider; the owner is signed in with the Anthropic key the fake accepts
the owner has one link filed under 'Software engineering' through PATCH /api/v1/links/{id}
the fake AI answers the new link's enrichment with the topic 'Software engineering > Testing'
end_state: the new link's card shows the topic 'Testing' with the tooltip 'Software engineering › Testing'
its detail page shows the breadcrumb 'Software engineering › Testing'
the Topics page lists 'Testing' indented under 'Software engineering'
the search topic:"software engineering" lists both links
the enrichment request the fake AI received lists 'Software engineering' without a count
smoke.pseudocode: extends e2e/topics.spec.ts: fakeAi.answerWhen('marker-tree-enriched', {summary, tags, topic: 'Software engineering > Testing'}); signIn(page); saveAiKey(page); [seed] = addLinkIds(page, ['https://tree.example/se-seed']); PATCH seed {topic: 'Software engineering'}; [id] = addLinkIds(page, ['https://code.example/tree-enriched']); page.goto('/'); expect cardOf(page, id)'s topic link 'Testing' with title 'Software engineering › Testing' within 60 s; page.goto('/links/' + id); expect the navigation 'Topic path' to read 'Software engineering›Testing'; page.goto('/topics'); expect the 'Testing' row at data-level 2 right after 'Software engineering'; page.goto('/search?q=topic%3A%22software%20engineering%22'); expect both cards; the last enrichment in fakeAi.requests() holds 'Software engineering' and no 'Software engineering ('
